reports.title: MARTIN MARIETTA REPORTS RECORD THIRD-QUARTER 2026 RESULTS AND UPDATES FULL-YEAR 2026 GUIDANCE

guidance.heading: Updated 2026 Guidance
section: Based on strong acquisition performance, partially offset by softer heritage demand and inflationary cost pressures, the Company is updating its full-year 2026 guidance.

(dollars in millions) | Low | Midpoint | High
Revenues | 7,750 | 7,800 | 7,850
Interest expense, net of interest income | 398 | 403 | 408
Estimated tax rate (excluding discrete events) | 20.5 | 21.0 | 21.5
Net earnings from continuing operations attributable to Martin Marietta | 727 | 800 | 873
Adjusted EBITDA from continuing operations1 | 2,450 | 2,475 | 2,500
Capital expenditures | 590 | 620 | 650
Volume % growth2 | 12.5 | 13.0 | 13.5
ASP % growth3 | (3.0 | )% | (2.5 | )% | (2.0 | )%
Gross profit | 1,540 | 1,590 | 1,640
Gross profit | 96 | 106 | 116
Gross profit | 345 | 375 | 405
1 Non-GAAP financial measure; see page 16 for reconciliation to net earnings from continuing operations attributable to Martin Marietta.
2 Volume change is based on total aggregates shipments and is in comparison to 2025 shipments of 198.5 million tons.
3 ASP change is based on aggregates average selling price and is in comparison to 2025 ASP of $23.30 per ton.
